newsitem.title: USA: Lifecore Biomedical reports on gel trial.
newsitem.headline: Lifecore Biomedical reports on gel trial.

text.p: Lifecore Biomedical Inc said Tuesday preliminary results from human trials of its Lubricoat 0.5-percent Ferric Hyaluronate Gel indicates the product reduces the number of adhesions following peritoneal cavity surgery.

The company, which expects to present more detailed results in June, said patients in the treatment group had a 45-percent lower incidence of a broad range of adhesions than control patients. Additionally, when adhesions occurred, the treated patients had less extensive and less severe adhesions than the control group, Lifecore said.

The company warned additional data from a larger clinical test was necessary to determine the exact statistical likelyhood of clinical success. A trial involving at least 200 patients is already under way and is slated to end by late September, Lifecore said.
Lifecore develops medical and surgical devices. Its shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 15.
